abstract: Three embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines F9, PCC4 Azal, and PCC3 N/1 with a common origin from the transplantable ascites teratoma OTT6050 were analyzed with regard to cell cycle characteristics during exponential growth in the undifferentiated state. The three lines, in the sequence mentioned, have been shown to represent successive stages in early normal mouse embryogenesis from morula to blastocyst, as reflected in their cell surface antigens. In the multipotent lines an increased intraclonal variability in intermitotic times was found when analyzing family trees. In the PCC3 N/1 line the distribution was almost bimodal. The increased intermitotic time variability was found to be represented in the G1 period that varied from less than 1 hr up to about 6 hr in the PCC3 N/1 line, with a mean value of 3.4 hr. The G1 period of the F9 line had a range of only 3.5 hr, with a mean value of 1.5 hr. The S-G2 period was found to be very similar in length in all three lines.
abstract_ja: F9、PCC4 Azal、PCC3 N/1という3種の胎児性癌(EC)細胞株は、いずれも腹水移植性奇形腫OTT6050に由来し、細胞表面抗原から見て、マウス初期胚発生における桑実胚から胚盤胞までの連続した段階を表すとされている。未分化な指数増殖期での細胞周期特性を解析した。多能性株では、系譜解析で分裂間期の時間に株内変動の増大が認められた。PCC3 N/1株では分布がほぼ二峰性であった。この分裂間期の変動はG1期の長さに現れており、PCC3 N/1株では1時間未満から約6時間まで変動し、平均は3.4時間であった。F9株のG1期は範囲が3.5時間しかなく、平均は1.5時間であった。S-G2期の長さは3株でよく似ていた。
